description: [Obsolète]Rémi - itinéraires du réseau de transport régional Rémi is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données est supprimé car plus maintenu. Il est remplacé par: REMI- Itinéraire du réseau de transport régional Ce jeu de données comporte l’ensemble des lignes du réseau de transport régional Rémi: lignes scolaires, régulières et virtuelles (transport sur réservation), c’est-à-dire des territoires du 18, 28, 36, 37, 41 et 45. Les ex. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, ramassage scolaire, interurbain, lignes régulières. The portal shows 8,925 records. The portal shows 2026-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
